book.meridian_witch.brew_arts.note: Hold the brew in the main hand. An interrupted cast keeps the brew.
technique.meridian_witch.imbibe.note: drink Bitter Yellow Paste or Qi Gathering Soup: stronger, longer, with half the nausea
technique.meridian_witch.anoint.note: rub Bitter Yellow Paste on the more wounded arms or legs: stronger, no nausea; the off hand must be empty
technique.meridian_witch.lob_seed.note: lob a splash brew up to 16 blocks; everyone it touches keeps a residue
technique.meridian_witch.fling_seed.note: fling a splash brew at up to four targets within 3.5 blocks ahead, leaving a residue
technique.meridian_witch.spray_trigger.n: spray a mouthful of the same brew: targets within 16 blocks carrying your residue are struck again at half strength
